heroes.name: Seraphiel
heroes.title: the Choir Eternal
heroes.bio: The last seraph who still sings the hymn that once held the sky together. Every note is a sunrise; every chorus, a judgment.
heroes.look: Statuesque, voluptuous pop goddess of heaven: six pearl-white wings with aqua tips, a large chrome halo ring, very long platinum hair. Pearl-white liquid-latex sling leotard plunging to the navel and open at the sides, pearl-vinyl stage drapes from chrome hip rings, chrome body chains, mirror-chrome platform heels. Raises a chrome tuning-fork microphone stand like a torch; eyes closed, a knowing half-smile.

ultimate.name: Hymn of Judgment
ultimate.description: Sings the sky's final verse: 180% ATK to all enemies and Stuns them for 1.5 s.

passives.name: Radiant Aria
passives.description: Basic attacks have a 25% chance to Stun the target for 1 s.

heroes.name: Cassiel
heroes.title: Aegis of Dawn
heroes.bio: Captain of the Gate Wardens. She has never taken a step backward, and she does not intend to start.
heroes.look: Athletic, curvy aero paladin: glossy white console-robot micro armor with small plate cups and aqua seams, oversized white-and-chrome pauldrons, gauntlets, bare midriff, thong-cut plate bottom, white mecha thigh greaves. A tall frosted aqua riot-glass kite shield planted at her side, hand on hip. Short silver bob, chrome visor tiara, white wings, chrome halo; a cocky smirk.

ultimate.name: Dawnwall
ultimate.description: Raises the Gate Wardens' wall: shields all allies for 10% of her max HP and grants them +20% DEF for 5 s.

passives.name: Morning Vigil
passives.description: Battle start: gains a shield equal to 25% of her max HP.

heroes.name: Liora
heroes.title: Hymn of Mending
heroes.bio: A temple novice whose lullabies close wounds. She is still learning which songs are safe to sing in battle.
heroes.look: Soft, curvy spa goddess with glam makeup: white string bikini strung with pearl chains, a pearl satin sarong at the hip, chrome anklets and heels, water droplets on her skin. Long rose-gold hair in a wet-look side braid, a frosted aqua glass lyre, pearl wings, a slim chrome halo. Leans toward the viewer with a slow, warm smile.

ultimate.name: Lullaby of Mending
ultimate.description: A lullaby that closes wounds: heals all allies for 240% ATK and grants Regen (40% ATK per second) for 4 s.

passives.name: Hymn of Plenty
passives.description: Battle start: all allies gain +10% max HP.

heroes.name: Uriela
heroes.title: the Sunlance
heroes.bio: A spear maiden of the outer bastions, eager to prove the old stories about her namesake true.
heroes.look: Toned, curvy sky racer: glossy azure-and-white racing leotard, highleg and thong-cut, with an underboob cutout and a navel window, sun-sigil decals, racing gloves, white platform racing boots. A chrome shield visor pushed up into a high honey-blonde ponytail; a chrome aero lance with a frosted aqua blade over her shoulder; pearl wings, thin chrome halo; a confident grin.

ultimate.name: Sunlance
ultimate.description: Hurls her blazing spear: 360% ATK to her target and breaks its armor, -40% DEF for 6 s.

heroes.name: Nuriel
heroes.title: the Lens Flare
heroes.bio: Heaven's fastest courier, until she started delivering knives. You see the flash on her visor; you never see her.
heroes.look: Lean, long-legged courier-assassin: aqua-chrome zip-front sport bandeau, glossy white thong-back sport brief, cropped white vinyl track jacket slipping off her shoulders, chrome thigh holsters, racing gloves, white platform trainers with bubble air soles. Mirrored chrome shield visor, platinum pixie cut with aqua tips, four jet-fin pearl wings, a thin chrome halo. Twin crystal daggers, one in reverse grip; a cool half-smile.

ultimate.name: Daybreak Ambush
ultimate.description: Dives to the back row: strikes the weakest back-row enemy twice for 170% ATK each and Stuns it for 1 s.

heroes.name: Mordessa
heroes.title: the Ember Queen
heroes.bio: Queen of the Ninth Furnace. She lost the war, kept the crown, and has decided the war is not over.
heroes.look: Voluptuous nightclub empress: huge curled chrome ram horns with a rhinestone crown, long wavy black hair with crimson ends. Candy-red metallic micro bikini with chrome O-rings, chrome chain belt, red latex thigh-high platform boots, and a floor-length black vinyl coat worn off the shoulders with a huge fur collar; cyber-sigil tattoos. A chrome greatsword with a painted flame edge on her shoulder, hand on hip; bat wings, spaded tail; a commanding smirk.

ultimate.name: Ninth Furnace
ultimate.description: Brings down the burning greatsword: 320% ATK to her target, 140% ATK to every other enemy, and Burns them all (50% ATK per second) for 4 s.

passives.name: Unending War
passives.description: On kill: restores 20% of her max HP and gains 300 energy.

heroes.name: Brakka
heroes.title: Brimstone Bulwark
heroes.bio: Undefeated in the Pit Arena, bouncer at the Brimstone club, and the only demon who hugs harder than she hits. Loyal to Mordessa, and to anyone who brings snacks.
heroes.look: Towering red-skinned bodybuilder demon, champion of hell's arena and bouncer at its club: glossy black micro bikini top with a chrome O-ring, black vinyl thong-cut bottom, a huge chrome-and-gold championship belt, chain chest harness, hot-rod engine gauntlets with exhaust pipes, black platform boots with flame decals. Bleached spiked hair with frosted tips, big chrome bull horns, small tusks, cyber-sigil tattoos, a thick tail. Double-biceps flex and a huge friendly grin.

ultimate.name: Magma Bulwark
ultimate.description: Plants her molten gauntlets: gains a shield of 40% max HP and Taunts all enemies for 5 s.

passives.name: Molten Hide
passives.description: Reflects 20% of damage taken back to the attacker.

heroes.name: Vesper
heroes.title: Mistress of Ember Rain
heroes.bio: A succubus scholar who reads the future in falling ash. Her forecasts are always right, and always fire.
heroes.look: Sultry hourglass hacker succubus: long straight wine-red hair, half-lidded eyes behind red-tinted rimless glasses, small glossy horns. Glossy crimson latex catsuit with a heart-shaped cleavage window, an underboob cutout and hip windows, black latex opera gloves, a high-collared open black vinyl cape lined in hot pink. A red glass hellfire orb ringed by chrome rings in one raised hand, adjusting her glasses with the other; bat wings, heart-spaded tail.

ultimate.name: Ember Rain
ultimate.description: Forecast: fire. 140% ATK to all enemies and Burns them (50% ATK per second) for 6 s.

passives.name: Ashen Forecast
passives.description: Basic attacks have a 35% chance to Burn the target (30% ATK per second) for 3 s.

heroes.name: Imra
heroes.title: Lantern of Pacts
heroes.bio: An imp shaman who brokers small, fair deals. Mostly fair. Fair-ish.
heroes.look: Lithe, toned adult fire dancer with glam makeup: crimson metallic bandeau bikini, chrome body jewelry (waist chain, arm cuffs, navel ring), UV cyber-sigil body paint, chrome gladiator platform sandals. A shoulder-length orange mane, large curved horns, pointed ears. Raises a lantern staff topped with a chrome-capped lava lamp; bat wings, curly tail; a sultry smirk.

ultimate.name: Lantern Pact
ultimate.description: Strikes a deal with the whole team: all allies +20% ATK for 5 s, and every other ally gains 100 energy.

passives.name: Fair-ish Deal
passives.description: Basic attacks have a 50% chance to Weaken the target: -15% ATK for 3 s.

passives.name: Lantern Light
passives.description: Battle start: all allies gain 150 energy.

heroes.name: Kessa
heroes.title: Ashen Claw
heroes.bio: A hellcat bounty hunter. Twelve contracts, twelve trophies, and one very full scrapbook.
heroes.look: Athletic, curvy cat burglar: black latex catsuit zipped open below the cleavage, a red chrome-ringed harness, thong-cut with hip windows, a long red vinyl scarf, black platform thigh boots. Chrome cat-ear headphones over short choppy black hair with a red streak, a red cat-eye visor pushed up, small horns, amber slit-pupil eyes, a smug smile. Twin black-chrome crescent sickles in a low, hip-cocked stance; a long cat tail.

ultimate.name: Twelfth Contract
ultimate.description: Pounces on the weakest enemy anywhere: 280% ATK, executing it if left below 25% HP (not bosses).

heroes.name: Noctaire
heroes.title: Eclipse Reaper
heroes.bio: Once Heaven's executioner, she cut her own wings rather than carry out one final order. She still keeps the blade.
heroes.look: Tall, slender glitch reaper: black latex sling leotard open at the sides, highleg, a long oil-slick holographic drape from chrome hip buckles, black latex opera gloves, heeled thigh boots. Long silver hair, cold violet eyes, a cracked chrome halo with pixel gaps, tattered black wings with pixel-block tips. A huge oil-slick chrome scythe with a violet edge, her free hand sweeping back her hair; melancholic allure.

ultimate.name: Eclipse Harvest
ultimate.description: Dives into the back row with her crescent scythe: 220% ATK to every back-row enemy, executing any left below 30% HP (not bosses).

heroes.name: Orrin
heroes.title: the Chained Oath
heroes.bio: She guarded the gate of a heaven that crashed. The gate is gone; the firewall isn't. Now she stands between her friends and everything else.
heroes.look: Tall, scarred guardian of a crashed heaven: glossy black vinyl monokini, highleg, with a chrome O-ring cutout at the sternum and cutouts at the waist, one heavy chrome pauldron, chrome gauntlets, smoked-acrylic thigh greaves, violet fiber-optic cables wrapped around her. A tall frosted smoked-acrylic riot shield with a broken loading-ring sigil. Long straight silver hair with a black underlayer, a scar through one eye, a cracked chrome halo at her hip, black wings with chrome tips; stoic.

ultimate.name: Chains of the Oath
ultimate.description: Lashes out with broken chains: 130% ATK to front-row enemies and Stuns them for 2.5 s, then Weakens all enemies (-25% ATK) for 6 s.

heroes.name: Sable
heroes.title: Censer of Dusk
heroes.bio: A fallen nun who still holds services in ruined chapels. Her congregation is mostly ghosts. They come every week.
heroes.look: Curvy cyber nun: skin-tight black latex habit-bodysuit with a plunging keyhole cutout, corset lacing and chrome trim, thong-cut, long black vinyl tabard panels open at the hips, black latex thighhighs on garters, platform heels. An opaque black coif under a holographic veil, dark-teal hair, a chrome cross. Swings a chrome censer orb; grey wings with an oil-slick sheen, a dim cracked halo; a gentle, sad smile.

ultimate.name: Dusk Requiem
ultimate.description: Swings the censer for the lost: all enemies -50% DEF for 8 s, and all allies heal for 200% ATK.

passives.name: Censer Smoke
passives.description: Basic attacks Expose the target: -25% DEF for 3 s.

passives.name: Vespers
passives.description: Each basic attack also heals the most wounded ally for 70% ATK.

heroes.name: Lucen
heroes.title: Splitwing
heroes.bio: Half of her fell. She styled the other half to match. She swears she hasn't picked a side; her rapier picks for her.
heroes.look: Slender duelist split down the middle: hair white on one side and black on the other, an asymmetric glossy white-and-black vinyl bodysuit cut diagonally (underboob on one side, sideboob on the other), thong-cut, one long sleeve; one white thigh-high platform boot and one bare leg with a garter ring; tinted oval sunglasses in her hair. One white pearl wing, one black chrome wing, no halo. Points a chrome rapier at the viewer, hip cocked, with a wink.

ultimate.name: Twinfeather Flurry
ultimate.description: A dazzling flurry: 5 strikes of 85% ATK at random enemies, then +25% SPD for 5 s.

passives.name: Flourish
passives.description: Basic attacks have a 30% chance to strike twice.

heroes.name: Ashra
heroes.title: Witch of Ash
heroes.bio: She burned her own heaven down by accident. Now she studies fire very, very carefully.
heroes.look: Sleepy vaporwave witch: an oversized holographic violet witch hat with chrome star pins, glossy violet robes slipping off her shoulders over a micro black tube top showing underboob and black micro shorts, a chrome chain belt, chunky silver headphones around her neck, platform ankle boots. Messy grey hair with violet streaks, a cracked chrome halo, small grey wings. One arm lazily raised, a chrome star wand in the other hand.

ultimate.name: Accidental Inferno
ultimate.description: Oops. 180% ATK to all enemies, +60% damage to enemies below 50% HP.

passives.name: Ash Cloud
passives.description: Her ultimate also Weakens all enemies: -15% ATK for 4 s.
